seo.title: How RAVU Works — Step-by-Step Guide
seo.description: How riders join RAVU, get verified and use member discounts, and how partners take part.

hero.title: How RAVU
hero.text: Riders and drivers join in the app and get verified. Partners agree member discounts. Members show their ID and pay less.

features.title: 1. Join via the app
features.text: Riders and drivers register directly in the RAVU mobile app.

features.title: 2. Get verified ID
features.text: Receive your digital RAVU Member ID for instant recognition.

features.title: 3. Unlock partner value
features.text: Access discounts, workshops and services across the network.

steps.title: Six steps,
steps.text: Six clear steps, each building on the last.

items.title: Discover RAVU
items.text: Learn what membership covers and who the partners are.

items.title: Register
items.text: Sign up in the mobile app or share your interest online to join the network.

items.title: Become a member
items.text: Complete verification and activate your digital RAVU Member ID.

items.title: Use partner services
items.text: Find partner garages, parts shops, fuel stations and insurers in the app.

items.title: Join the community
items.text: Take part in safety training and local rider meet-ups.

items.title: Keep saving
items.text: Lower running costs every month you stay a member.

cards.title: Members at the Centre
cards.text: Members are riders, drivers and vehicle owners. Everything RAVU builds is judged by whether it saves them money or time.

cards.title: Partners around them
cards.text: Partners offer discounts on maintenance, fuel, insurance and finance in return for a steady flow of verified customers.
